notes.title: 1.0.0 Released!
notes.notes:
We're really pleased to announce the launch of Hidden Cubes!

Releasing today with over 60 levels (with more on the way!) Hopefully there aren't any major, or otherwise terrible, bugs. We were up late last night making final tweaks and polishing it for this very moment.

We hope you enjoy this little game!
